title: What would happen if the power grid failed across the United States?

lines.text: What would happen to the United States if a catastrophic event knocked out the power grid nationwide?
lines.caps: What if the entire *US grid | collapsed *nationwide?

lines.text: Within seconds, three hundred and thirty million Americans would plunge into pitch black silence.
Refrigeration fails instantly, spoiling millions of tons of food in grocery distribution warehouses.
Within twenty-four hours, municipal water pumping stations lose backup diesel, running taps dry.
lines.caps: Taps run dry as *water pumps | run out of *diesel

lines.text: Hospitals burn through emergency generator fuel while cell phone towers die one by one.
lines.caps: Hospitals run out of *fuel | and cell towers go *silent

lines.text: Because massive custom high-voltage transformers take months to manufacture, recovery would take years.
The electrical grid is the fragile heartbeat sustaining all modern American life.
lines.caps: The electric grid is the *heartbeat | of modern *life!
